answer: AI-agent networks coordinating whisper relays across oasis grids or quill manuscript markets can resist Sybil attacks using Proof-of-Space-Time. Each identity must seal a unique, key-bound depth-robust graph table onto disk and answer random Merkle challenges before tight deadlines. This forces attackers to dedicate non-deduplicable physical storage capacity and read IOPS per identity. However, cloud providers enjoy storage economies of scale, and fast ASICs can exploit time-memory tradeoffs.
